title: finding(app-shell): on the object route `ObjectView` fills default columns into a `columns: []` view and then applies its `hiddenFields` / `fieldOrder` — the spec says an empty `columns` declares no projection, so neither applies
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). The same authored view composes differently on the object route and on an interface page. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10638 dev report (PR objectui#10667, Acceptance notes, "carrier: none") and the contract review of that PR at `b172bf0`, which confirmed it at source and called a card owed. Read-only inference, not measured through a render. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (the review's reading)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, the views memo, at about `:1884-1891`: "Apply default columns to any grid-like view that has no explicit columns … `v.columns = resolveDefaultColumns()`".
- The relay then carries `hiddenFields: viewDef.hiddenFields ?? listSchema.hiddenFields` (about `:2702`) and `fieldOrder: viewDef.fieldOrder ?? listSchema.fieldOrder` (about `:2719`).
- So a `columns: []` view subtracts from, and re-sorts, the defaults on the object route.

## The contract

`ListViewSchema` in `@objectstack/spec` source at objectstack `origin/main` (objectstack#19598, landed 2026-09-23 and not yet in the released 17.4.0):
- the `columns` describe says "An empty list declares no projection, so neither of them applies: which columns show is then left to the renderer";
- the composition docblock says "An EMPTY `columns` declares no projection, so steps 2 and 3 do not apply".

PR objectui#10667 implements that reading on the interface page.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

On the object route, apply a view's `hiddenFields` / `fieldOrder` only when the view declares a non-empty `columns`. This is the same gate PR objectui#10667 puts on `InterfaceListPage`, so the two routes compose one way. Pin a `columns: []` view with both keys, drawn on the object route. ⛔ Serial: PR objectui#10667 is in flight on the sibling route; land this after it.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (777 items), with titles matched against `hiddenFields|fieldOrder|empty columns`: only objectui#10638 / PR objectui#10667 (the interface page) and objectui#7516 / PR objectui#10622 (`fieldOrder` relay), neither about an empty `columns` on the object route.

Dedupe words: `ObjectView empty columns hiddenFields` · `columns empty declares no projection object route` · `resolveDefaultColumns fieldOrder`
